    • getRenewDeadline

      @Bindable(defaultValue="8s") Duration getRenewDeadline()
      The lock renew deadline. If the leader elector fails to renew the lock within the deadline, then the controller loses the lock. Default "8s".
      Returns:
      renew deadline
